result.instructions: Tools for FireText, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many SMS credits do I have left on my account today?"; "How many texts did I send last month and how many credits did they use?"; "Who has opted out of receiving my text messages so far?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes FireText data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run firetext_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run firetext_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run firetext_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. firetext_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: firetext_get_credit
tools.title: Get SMS credit
tools.description: Number of SMS credits (messages) remaining on the FireText account or a sub-account. FireText: /credit.

subaccount.description: Sub-account ID (only when the account has the sub-account module). Omit for the main account.

tools.name: firetext_list_received_messages
tools.title: List received messages
tools.description: Inbound SMS received on the account's FireText numbers/keywords (messageID, sentTo, keyword, receivedFrom, receivedOn, message). Dates YYYY-MM-DD; from="last" returns only what is new since the last call. FireText: /receivedmessages.

from.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD, or "last" for only what is new since the last access.

subaccount.description: Sub-account ID (only when the account has the sub-account module). Omit for the main account.

tools.name: firetext_list_sent_messages
tools.title: List sent messages
tools.description: Messages (campaigns) sent from the account: messageID, sentOn, sentTo (group), recipientCount, message. The messageID is what the delivery and click reports need. Dates YYYY-MM-DD. FireText: /sentmessages.

from.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD, or "last" for only what is new since the last access.

subaccount.description: Sub-account ID (only when the account has the sub-account module). Omit for the main account.

tools.name: firetext_get_sent_summary
tools.title: Get sent summary
tools.description: Totals for a date range: number of campaigns, recipients and credits used. FireText: /sentreport.

subaccount.description: Sub-account ID (only when the account has the sub-account module). Omit for the main account.

tools.name: firetext_list_scheduled_messages
tools.title: List scheduled messages
tools.description: Messages queued for later sending (messageID, queuedOn, scheduledFor, recipientCount, sourceAddress, sendTo, message). FireText: /scheduledmessages.

subaccount.description: Sub-account ID (only when the account has the sub-account module). Omit for the main account.

tools.name: firetext_get_delivery_report
tools.title: Get delivery report
tools.description: Per-recipient delivery status of one sent message (mobile, names, messageSent, messageUpdate, status: Delivered / Declined / Buffered / Pending with Network / Rejected / Unconfirmed). Give the FireText message id OR the custom reference used when sending. FireText: /deliveryreport.

reference.description: The custom reference set when sending (alternative to message).

pp.description: Results per page: 10000 or 25000 (the vendor's only choices for this report). Large; omit for the vendor default.

subaccount.description: Sub-account ID (only when the account has the sub-account module). Omit for the main account.

tools.name: firetext_get_click_report
tools.title: Get click report
tools.description: Link clicks for one sent message (mobile, names, clicked, userAgent). Only for messages that used FireText's Trackable SMS feature (otherwise the vendor answers URL error). FireText: /clickreport.

pp.description: Results per page: 10000 or 25000 (the vendor's only choices for this report). Large; omit for the vendor default.

subaccount.description: Sub-account ID (only when the account has the sub-account module). Omit for the main account.

tools.name: firetext_get_contact
tools.title: Get contact
tools.description: Stored details of one contact by mobile number (firstname, lastname, mobile, customField1-3). FireText: /contactinfo.

mobile.description: Mobile number: UK 07700900123 / 447700900123, or international without + and leading zeros (e.g. 33612345678).

subaccount.description: Sub-account ID (only when the account has the sub-account module). Omit for the main account.

tools.name: firetext_list_unsubscribed
tools.title: List unsubscribed contacts
tools.description: Contacts that opted out (names, mobile, custom fields, addedOn, unsubscribedOn, reason). Optional date range and group API id. FireText: /unsubscribed.

from.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD, or "last" for only what is new since the last access.

group.description: Group API ID to restrict to one group.

subaccount.description: Sub-account ID (only when the account has the sub-account module). Omit for the main account.

tools.name: firetext_list_keywords
tools.title: List keywords
tools.description: SMS keywords on the account (keywordID, number, keyword, reference). FireText: /keywords.

subaccount.description: Sub-account ID (only when the account has the sub-account module). Omit for the main account.

tools.name: firetext_send_sms
tools.title: Send SMS
tools.description: WRITE, SPENDS MONEY: sends a REAL SMS to real phones and uses the account's SMS credits (one credit per 160 GSM characters per recipient; long and unicode messages cost more). Cannot be undone. At most 10 recipients per call; no groups, templates, scheduling or repeats. Only call after the user confirmed the exact text, sender and numbers. FireText: /sendsms.

items.description: Mobile number: UK 07700900123 / 447700900123, or international without + and leading zeros (e.g. 33612345678).

to.description: Recipient mobile numbers (1-10): UK 07... / 447..., or international without + and leading zeros.

message.description: Message text (UTF-8), up to 612 characters (160 per single GSM SMS, 153 per part when longer; unicode 70/66).

from.description: Sender ID shown on the handset: 3-11 characters, letters and digits only (a company name or a reply number).

reference.description: Optional custom reference stored against the message (usable in firetext_get_delivery_report).

unicode.description: 0 = GSM characters only (default), 1 = always unicode, 2 = auto-detect from the text.

subaccount.description: Sub-account ID (only when the account has the sub-account module). Omit for the main account.

tools.name: firetext_subscribe_contact
tools.title: Add or update contact
tools.description: WRITE: adds a contact (by mobile number) to the FireText account, optionally into a group, or with update=true refreshes the names/custom fields of an existing contact. Does not send any SMS. A contact that opted out cannot be re-added this way (they must rejoin by SMS). FireText: /subscribe.

mobile.description: Mobile number: UK 07700900123 / 447700900123, or international without + and leading zeros (e.g. 33612345678).

group.description: Group API ID to add the contact to.

update.description: true = overwrite firstname, lastname and custom1-3 of an existing contact.

subaccount.description: Sub-account ID (only when the account has the sub-account module). Omit for the main account.

tools.name: firetext_unsubscribe_contact
tools.title: Unsubscribe contact
tools.description: WRITE: opts a contact out of the FireText account (all groups by default), so it no longer receives group messages. The contact can only rejoin by SMS. Does not send any SMS. FireText: /unsubscribe.

mobile.description: Mobile number: UK 07700900123 / 447700900123, or international without + and leading zeros (e.g. 33612345678).

group.description: Group API ID, only if the account unsubscribes per group.

subaccount.description: Sub-account ID (only when the account has the sub-account module). Omit for the main account.

prompts.title: Get started with FireText
prompts.description: What you can do with FireText here, with example requests to try.
